title: anandtopu/mock-agents
description: Simulate, test, and validate AI agent integrations — without calling real LLMs or burning tokens.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

description: A headless, multi-provider AI agent harness — embed it as a library, script it from the CLI, or run it as a stateful agent server. One orchestrator drives every major LLM provider.

description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: maddefientist/agentssot
description: A cross-LLM shared memory service give every AI agent durable, scoped, semantic memory. Save 50% or more on your token usage

title: Generalized-Labs/ironrun
description: Sealed command execution for AI agents. Secrets never enter LLM context windows, logs, or stdout.

title: SAP/STARS

title: hec-ovi/gamentic
description: Self-hosted, browser-based AI dungeon RPG, fully local on an AMD Strix Halo APU: narrator + per-character agents on one local LLM (Gemma 4 26B MoE via llama.cpp/Vulkan), local images (FLUX.2 klein/ComfyUI), expressive voice (Maya1 TTS). FastAPI brain, SQLite, vanilla JS, docker-compose with guided setup (CLI wizard or double-click HTML).

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: 7yuling/ATEE
description: ATEE is a lightweight AI security agent plugin deployed on the website administrator's server or a security node within the same intranet. title: ashok-kallara/semantic-daily
description: A 100% free agentic news aggregator that discovers trending AI & technology content from Native APIs (Reddit, Bluesky, GitHub, RSS, HackerNews, YouTube, and Exa.ai) — deduplicates, categorizes using a multi-agent LLM pipeline over OpenRouter, and delivers a curated daily digest directly to your Telegram or as a Web Dashboard.

title: marcoantonios1/Forge
description: Terminal-native AI coding agent powered by multiple LLMs. Like Claude Code, but model-agnostic — use local or cloud models via Costguard.

title: Orkas-AI/Orkas
